subject: Configure served directory when using user_dirs

messages.author: 69658a5d047f38b4
messages.subject: Configure served directory when using user_dirs
parts:
Hi everyone,

When using user_dirs in shiny server, the directory "ShinyApps" in each user home directory is served. Is it possible to configure the name of that directory to be something else (like mod_userdirs allows for Apache)? For some unfortunate reason ShinyApps was used for other stuff by some users and I would like to avoid renaming everything behind the users back.

Thanks in advance. Sincerely,
